notes: 6-channel analogue club/DJ mixer with dual built-in USB audio interfaces. Desktop unit (no rackUnits — not rack-mountable). Port data drawn from the official Xone:96 User Guide (AP11645) as mirrored on ManualsLib (Rear Panel Connectors pages, Top Panel headphone section, and Specifications page), cross-checked against B&H/DJ TechTools/Sweetwater retailer copy and the official Allen & Heath support article (support.allen-heath.com/hc/en-gb/articles/43053562464017) which returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch. Caveats: (1) USB 1/USB 2 are USB-B, dual 24-channel (6 stereo in/6 stereo out) 32-bit/96kHz soundcards described as "Hi-Speed USB" — graded usb-2.0 since no USB 3.x spec is stated. (2) X:LINK is a proprietary RJ45/Cat5 link to Xone:K series controllers (MIDI/control over Ethernet cabling), not a standard graded Ethernet network port, so no eth-* grade was set. (3) RTN A / RTN B are shown in the manual as one line item each per mic/return channel (paralleling the mono MIC A/MIC B XLR inputs); some retailer copy describes channels A/B as having "stereo 1/4-inch line inputs," so an additional R jack per channel is possible but not confirmed from the primary source — modeled here as single balanced TRS jacks. (4) RTN C/RTN D are modelled as the L/R pair of one unbalanced auxiliary stereo return. (5) Two independent headphone amp circuits each provide a 1/4" TRS and a 1/8" (3.5mm) mini-jack (4 physical sockets total) per general retailer/manual description. (6) MIDI I/O also happens virtually over USB1/USB2 (2 in/2 out) per the spec page — only the single physical 5-pin DIN MIDI OUT is listed as a physical port. (7) Power: internal auto-sensing SMPS, 100–240V AC 50/60Hz, ~45W max, IEC C13/14 inlet with integrated on/off switch.
